==Description==
'''Bow''' is an emote that could have been obtained at Level 9 of the regular [[The Final Act Event#The Final Act Battle Pass|The Final Act Battle Pass]] track. It was made by STEALTH_NOVA. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote. The player is unable to move while performing the emote or interact with it.

Upon use, roses will be thrown towards the player while an applause plays in the background.

It had a cost of {{PlushieSnowman|220}} or {{Robux|123}} ({{Robux|98}} during the Christmas 2025 Sale), with a total cost of {{PlushieSnowman|1,000}} or {{Robux|540}} ({{Robux|428}} during the Christmas 2025 Sale).
